threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the tube' means a quick jaunt to the West End, not a frantic scramble just to get to Victoria.
The other night on the 45, I spotted a guy singing to his own reflection in the window, completely unbothered by the rest of us. Classic Brixton moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid cycling with a baguette in one hand and a skateboard under the other, I thought, yeah, this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a spontaneous techno party erupting in the middle of a street during the day, complete with DJs and a crowd of unbothered locals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they casually mention that the BART delays are always worse on Fridays, but they still never take the bus to the city.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy serenading the 31 bus with a ukulele today. Must’ve been a well-rehearsed set, whole ride turned into a mini concert. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best time to visit Plaça del Sol is in the daytime. But it’s the evenings when the locals actually come alive and gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they ask for directions to the nearest 'metro' instead of 'subte' while looking genuinely confused.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a ‘bottle shop’ just sells bottles and not craft beers. And you ask for a flat white like you're in a tourist café.
Last night on the 333, a bloke serenaded us with a 20-minute rendition of 'Wonderwall' while the driver looked on, mildly amused.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I passed a street musician playing an accordion while a couple danced next to a food truck selling the best döner. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find a late-night kebab stand that doubles as an art gallery, complete with local artists' work on the walls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If you know to avoid the BART platform at Civic Center during rush hour, you’re probably from here. Tourists seem shocked every time it shuts down.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy singing opera on the 31 Balboa this morning. Whole bus went quiet, then joined in on the chorus. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think tapas means sharing small plates, but locals often enjoy their own, a quiet moment with a few olives and a vermut amid the buzz.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still look puzzled when the clock strikes 11 and the bars start to fill up. A true local knows it's just the pre-party warm-up.
